protocol_violation: The protocol required the complete 160-case index65 screening table and disagreement list to be durably persisted and read back before any post-index65 outcome was revealed. In this run the complete screening existed only in the private execution notebook when the sole disagreement tail was evaluated. No model coefficient, threshold, feature, or policy rule was changed before or after that reveal, but this result is exploratory/audit evidence rather than strict confirmatory evidence.

frozen_model_failure_analysis.interpretation: The only unique learned override on this n18 pool was a false positive: it bought 519 extra candidate compilations and recovered no verified quality gain. The retained incumbent preserved the no-harm invariant.
frozen_model_failure_analysis.scope_warning: The logistic model was fitted on n=12 and n=14 development states and had one n=16 confirmation. This n=18 result is an extrapolation test. A single false-positive disagreement does not establish general failure, but it is strong evidence against treating a high uncalibrated probability as a positive tail-value certificate outside development support.

next_experiment_requirements: Use a fresh untouched split and durably persist/read back every pre-outcome screening decision before revealing any tail outcome.
Keep two-arm as incumbent and learned search strictly optional/no-harm.
Measure unique learned override gain versus the simple v1 rule and unique extra tail compilation cost as co-primary outcomes.
Evaluate an abstaining support/OOD guard derived only from development data, without tuning on seed 892331.
Prefer a blockwise sequential value-of-computation or survival/hazard target such as probability of verified improvement within the next fixed compute block over an unbounded any-future binary label.
Report false-negative missed gain, open/abstention rate, and per-case no-harm invariant.
scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD variable-order search only; no theorem-proving transfer claim.
